entities.name: Chimera
entities.description: A mythological fire-breathing monster of disparate parts; on Theros, magical fusions of creatures' life essences.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God on Theros who, in an Akroan tale, created chimeras to test Renata.

entities.name: Renata
entities.description: Hunter in an Akroan tale who slew Keranos's creations.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where chimeras are magical fusions.

entities.name: Hofri Ghostforge
entities.description: Professor on Arcavios who has employed a chimera spirit statue as a docent.

events.summary: In an Akroan tale, Keranos creates a deadly beast to test Renata; she slays the first chimera of Theros effortlessly.
events.quote: When Renata slayed this lion-ram-dragon creation effortlessly (the first chimera of Theros)

relations.note: Suspected and, per an Akroan tale, said to have created chimeras.
relations.quote: Keranos created another combination of deadlier beasts to challenge her.
She slayed that beast too, and all the other countless Keranos' creations.
